lean.statement:
∀ {d q : ℕ} (hq : 2 * q + 1 < d),
  let D := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)
  let E := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (q + 1))
  let Ω := Fin (q + 1) → D
  let μ : Measure Ω := Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin (q + 1) => stdGaussian D)
  let M := Matrix (Fin (q + 1) × Fin (q + 1)) (Fin (q + 1) × Fin (q + 1)) ℝ
  let r : ℝ := ((q + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)
  let L : ℝ := 2 * r + 3 * Real.log (1000 * (d : ℝ))
  let α : Fin d → ℝ := fun i => ((i.val : ℝ) + 1 - 1 / 2) * Real.pi / (d : ℝ)
  let tvec : Fin d → Fin (q + 1) → ℝ := fun i k =>
    if k.val = 0 then 1 else Real.sqrt 2 * Real.cos ((k.val : ℝ) * α i)
  let row : Fin d → Ω → E := fun i ω =>
    WithLp.toLp 2 (fun b : Fin (q + 1) => ω b i)
  let Y : Fin d → Ω → M := fun i ω =>
    if ‖row i ω‖ ^ 2 ≤ L then
      (d : ℝ)⁻¹ • Matrix.kronecker
        (Matrix.vecMulVec (WithLp.ofLp (row i ω)) (WithLp.ofLp (row i ω)))
        (Matrix.vecMulVec (tvec i) (tvec i))
    else 0
  let mean : Fin d → M := fun i => ∫ ω, Y i ω ∂μ
  let Z : Fin d → Ω → M := fun i ω => Y i ω - mean i
  let w : Bool → Fin d → ℝ := fun useCos i =>
    if useCos = true then Real.cos (((2 * q + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * α i) else 1
  let sign : Bool → ℝ := fun minus => if minus = true then -1 else 1
  let S : Bool → Bool → Ω → M := fun useCos minus ω =>
    sign minus • ∑ i : Fin d, w useCos i • Z i ω
  let Rstar : ℝ := 2 * r * (L + 1) / (d : ℝ)
  ∀ s : ℝ, ∀ useCos minus : Bool,
    let G : Ω → M := fun ω => NormedSpace.exp (s • S useCos minus ω)
    let MX : M := ∫ ω, G ω ∂μ
    let B : ℝ := r ^ 2 * Real.exp (|s| * ((d : ℝ) * Rstar))
    Integrable G μ ∧ MX.PosDef ∧
      Matrix.trace MX = (∫ ω, Matrix.trace (G ω) ∂μ) ∧
      0 < Matrix.trace MX ∧ Matrix.trace MX ≤ B
approved_definition_context: Matrix ι ι ℝ is the finite real square-matrix algebra; Fintype supplies a finite enumeration and DecidableEq equality decisions. No Nonempty typeclass is present.
A.PosDef denotes a Hermitian real matrix whose quadratic form is strictly positive on each nonzero vector. Over ℝ Hermitian means transpose equality.

Measure Ω is a measure on the given measurable space. IsProbabilityMeasure means total mass one. Integrable f μ is Bochner integrability of the displayed matrix-valued function, and ∫ω,f ω∂μ is its Bochner integral under precisely μ.
∀ᵐω∂μ means for μ-almost every ω. Type universes u and v permit independent index and outcome types.
EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) is the n-dimensional real Euclidean space. WithLp.toLp 2 and WithLp.ofLp change coordinate representation without changing coordinates.
stdGaussian denotes the centered standard Gaussian law and Measure.pi forms the displayed finite product measure.
Matrix.vecMulVec is the displayed outer product; Matrix.kronecker has paired indices in the displayed factor order. An if expression uses its literal inclusive comparison and zero-matrix branch.
Fin d enumerates zero through d−1; the angle adds one explicitly. The universally quantified Booleans select the displayed deterministic weight and one global scalar sign.

NormedSpace.exp is the power-series exponential in the matrix algebra, not entrywise exponentiation. Real.exp is scalar exponential. Matrix.trace is the ordinary unnormalized diagonal sum. The scoped matrix norm is the Euclidean/L2 operator norm.
